mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts ( account_id, user_id, kb_account_id, account_status, account_name ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{userId}, #{kbAccountId}, #{accountStatus}, #{accountName} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, k.account_type, k.account_number, k.bank_name, k.balance, a.account_status, a.synced_at FROM accounts a JOIN kb_accounts k ON a.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND k.account_type = #{accountType} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id, a.user_id, a.kb_account_id, k.account_type, a.account_status, a.account_name, a.created_at, a.synced_at, a.updated_at FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON a.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT a.account_id, k.balance, a.synced_at FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON a.kb_account_id = k.kb_account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}
